_meta.purpose: Competition peaking and taper protocol. Eligible for powerlifting-goal lifters only, and excluded for intensity-capped populations (youth, older-adult).

name: Competition Peaking & Taper
description: 2-week taper into a competition or maximal-effort test. Cut volume progressively while maintaining or slightly increasing intensity. Not a deload — a strategic peak.

phases.name: volume_taper
phases.label: Volume Taper
phases.notes: Keep 60% of normal volume. Maintain intensity. Dial in technique with heavy-ish sets.

phases.name: intensity_taper
phases.label: Intensity Taper
phases.notes: Keep 40% of normal volume. Work up to 97% TM singles/doubles. Leave the body fresh for competition day.
